name: mapps-camera
description: Drives the MAPPS map camera through a fixed zoom cycle and returns to the starting zoom, so successive runs cover the same geometry. Requires MAPPS running with inspection enabled (scripts/build-desktop.ps1 -Run -Inspection) and its Docker stack up.
//: Four zoom-ins followed by four zoom-outs returns the camera to where it started. docs/M0_performance_baselines.md recorded two runs differing by ~50% precisely because relative zoom clicks were not balanced and each run drifted to a different zoom depth, covering different geometry densities.
//budgets: Deliberately absent. The recorded baseline is 15-24x over the plan's Go-side budget today, before any migration work. Gating this scene on the absolute target would fail every run for a pre-existing condition; use -baseline to catch regressions instead, and see docs/M0_performance_baselines.md.
